Hero.title: From idea to production,
Hero.description: An opinionated Next.js starter for modern teams: Turnstile-protected Google authentication, i18n, typed APIs, observability, a component system, and container deployment.

Features.title: Production primitives that usually matter only after an application grows.
Features.description: Every primitive comes with clear boundaries, an implementation example, and an upgrade path—not merely an installed dependency.
Features.serverDescription: Server Components keep client JavaScript small and sensitive data on the server.
Features.authDescription: Google OAuth, server and client sessions, protected routes, sign-in and sign-out flows.
Features.i18nDescription: Locale routing, typed navigation, translation messages, and a language switcher.
Features.apiDescription: Global typed fetch, timeout, retry, schema parsing, response factories, and normalized errors.
Features.uiDescription: Button, input, card, select, date picker, skeleton, empty state, and lazy components.
Features.qualityDescription: Lint, types, unit tests, E2E, production builds, Docker, and CI.

Architecture.title: Architecture that stays readable as the team and product grow.
Architecture.description: Routes focus on navigation, features own business domains, components hold reusable UI, and lib provides cross-feature infrastructure.

Quality.title: Quality gates run before users discover the problem.

Components.title: Form components ready for real products.
Components.description: Select and date picker are dynamically imported so they do not burden the initial bundle.
